hist-isl-01-c2.text: World History Encyclopedia. Prophet Muhammad. World History Encyclopedia.
hist-isl-01-c2.claim: His 622 CE migration to Medina, called the Hijra, marks the start of the Islamic calendar.

hist-isl-01-c3.text: Syed Muhammad Khan (2019). Islam. World History Encyclopedia.
hist-isl-01-c3.quote: After the Quran, an important source of guidance for the Muslims is the life of the Prophet: his ways (Sunna) and his sayings (Hadith)
hist-isl-01-c3.claim: The religious basis is the Quran (revealed text) and the Hadith (sayings and actions of Muhammad).

hist-isl-02-c2.text: Syed Muhammad Khan (2020). Rashidun Caliphate. World History Encyclopedia.
hist-isl-02-c2.quote: His claim was not uncontested, as a group of Muslims called Shia't Ali (party of Ali) pushed for Ali as the only legitimate candidate for the caliphate, but Abu Bakr's authority prevailed.
hist-isl-02-c2.claim: The split between Sunni and Shia Muslims originated in disputes over leadership succession after Muhammad.
